verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a data and automation platform like Databricks, but the evidence pack never documents a bulk or batch action that operates across many workspace items (jobs, tables, notebooks, permissions) at once. The CLI, Python SDK and REST APIs are only described as general automation building blocks that a user could script bulk actions with, and the batch-computation and ETL items concern data processing rather than bulk item operations, so neither counts as the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
